target_rationale: Predeclared round C4-en threshold below the best fully validated initial-pilot loss 4.149783611297607. Chosen using initial pilots only, before any long-run outcomes. All confirmations use the same held-out metric and threshold; no claim that every configuration will reach it.
threshold_not_reached_policy: Run all 37335 updates; report not reached within schedule, without extrapolated crossing time.
schedule_termination_policy: Never terminate at threshold; execute the entire prescribed schedule.
scope_limit: Only the fully settled alpha0 seed0 configuration may start before global selection. All remaining exponent/ridge decisions use pilots and recursive expansions only.
